init.title: Power Management
init.description: Choose which optional segments to enable below. Solar PV Plant itself is always included.

data_description.ev_charging: Manage EV charger scheduling and load control, e.g. charging on solar surplus or off-peak spot prices.
data_description.pool: Manage pool pump/heater scheduling, e.g. running the pump during solar surplus hours.
data_description.pv_surplus: Manage what happens to solar production left over once the battery and other loads are covered.

pv_inverter.title: Solar PV Plant
pv_inverter.description: Which inverter do you have? Picking one lets PwMngt auto-fill several of the next page's fields for you.

solar_pv_plant.title: Solar PV Plant
solar_pv_plant.description: Pick the entity in your own Home Assistant that PwMngt should mirror for each value below.{auto_filled_note}

data_description.battery_soc: The entity that reports your home battery's state of charge (%), e.g. your inverter's battery SoC sensor. Only "%"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_pv_charged: The entity that reports total energy charged into the battery (kWh) from your solar plant, e.g. from your inverter. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. With Growatt Modbus, leave empty: PwMngt calculates it as Battery Charge Total minus AC Charge Energy Total.
data_description.battery_pv_discharged: The entity that reports total energy discharged from the battery (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_power: The entity that reports the battery's current charge/discharge power (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.invert_battery_power: Tick if the battery power entity reports charging as positive. PwMngt expects positive = discharging. Ticked automatically for Growatt Modbus.
data_description.battery_grid_charged_day: The entity that reports how much energy has been charged into the battery from the grid today (kWh) -- a daily counter that resets at midnight, e.g. your inverter's own "charge from grid today" sensor. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically from your inverter if it's a supported brand. Used to tell grid-charged battery content from PV-charged.

data_description.pv1_power: The entity that reports PV string 1's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv2_power: The entity that reports PV string 2's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a second PV string.
data_description.pv3_power: The entity that reports PV string 3's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a third PV string.

data_description.grid_power: The entity that reports current power flow to/from the grid (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.invert_grid_power: Tick if the grid power entity reports export as positive. PwMngt expects positive = buying from the grid. Ticked automatically for Growatt Modbus.
data_description.pv_direct_consumption: The entity that reports power currently consumed directly from PV production (W), without going through the battery. Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. With Growatt Modbus, leave empty: PwMngt calculates it from House Consumption, PV, grid import and battery discharge.
data_description.pv_total_consumption: The entity that reports total cumulative PV consumption (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. With Growatt Modbus, leave empty: PwMngt sums PV direct consumption over time.
data_description.property_consumption_total: The entity that reports the whole property's cumulative energy consumption (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- e.g. your inverter's own lifetime consumption sensor. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically from your inverter if it's a supported brand -- pick a different entity if you don't want that. Do not point this at a Daily Utility Meter helper -- PwMngt tracks its own local-midnight reset internally, so it needs the raw, never-resetting counter instead.

data_description.pv_forecast_today: The entity that reports today's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.
data_description.pv_forecast_tomorrow: The entity that reports tomorrow's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.

data_description.spot_electricity_price: The entity that reports your current total electricity price including VAT/tariffs (kr/kWh) -- not the raw spot price -- e.g. Strømligning's own VAT-inclusive price sensor. Only "kr/kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.electricity_price_surcharge: A fixed amount (kr/kWh, incl. VAT) your supplier adds on top of the price above, if your configured price entity doesn't already include it -- e.g. a flat per-kWh markup. Added to that price everywhere PwMngt calculates money from it. Leave at 0 if your price entity already reflects what you actually pay.

data_description.main_fuse_load_l1: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L1 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.
data_description.main_fuse_load_l2: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L2 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.
data_description.main_fuse_load_l3: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L3 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.

data_description.sell_force_override: An input_boolean, switch, or binary_sensor your own automations can turn on to force the battery into selling mode right now, regardless of what PwMngt's own price/forecast calculation would otherwise decide. One-way only -- it can only force selling, never prevent it. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have an automation like this; the sell decision then runs purely on its own calculation.

data_description.electricity_tax_full_rate: Your own sensor reporting the current full electricity-tax rate (kr/kWh, incl. VAT), e.g. Strømligning's tax sensor. Used to calculate the fictional "purchase price without PV" (what you'd pay if 100% of your consumption had to be bought from the grid) and the savings sensors below, together with select.<hub>_billing_period and select.<hub>_electricity_tax on the Configuration tab, which decide the tax threshold and whether the reduced rate applies at all. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't track this; those sensors then stay unavailable.
data_description.household_consumption_hourly: The entity that reports your household's total consumption (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter, not a Daily/Hourly Utility Meter helper -- PwMngt derives each hour's own figure itself, and tolerates the counter resetting or you repointing this field at a new entity later (e.g. after replacing an inverter). Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.grid_import_hourly: The entity that reports electricity imported from the grid (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- same reasoning as the field above. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.battery_grid_charge_hourly: The entity that reports energy charged into the battery from the grid specifically (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- same reasoning as the field above. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.battery_discharge_hourly: The entity that reports energy the battery discharged to the house (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- same reasoning as the field above. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.

data_description.seed_purchase_price_real: If you're migrating from an existing Node-RED setup tracking this same running total (kr), point this at that old sensor so PwMngt's own total starts from its current value instead of 0. Checked every time this wizard is completed, and only ever raises PwMngt's own total up to this sensor's current value -- never lowers it, so it's safe to re-run this wizard any time. Leave empty ("Not available") on a fresh install with no history to carry over. "Own production savings" is then derived automatically from this and the field below, instead of needing its own seed.
data_description.seed_purchase_price_real_without_pv: Same idea as above, for the "purchase price without PV (real)" running total.
data_description.seed_battery_grid_charge_sum: Same idea as above, for the "battery charged from grid" running total. "Battery charging savings" is then derived automatically from this and the field below, instead of needing its own seed.
data_description.seed_battery_grid_discharge_sum: Same idea as above, for the "battery discharged from grid" running total.

missing_solcast_solar.title: Solcast PV Forecast is not installed
missing_solcast_solar.description:
PwMngt's "PV forecast today" and "PV forecast tomorrow" fields (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expect a whole-plant solar forecast sensor (kWh), which normally comes from the **Solcast PV Forecast** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for those two required fields, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Solcast PV Forecast (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its forecast sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Solcast PV Forecast is installed.

missing_stromligning.title: Strømligning is not installed
missing_stromligning.description:
PwMngt's "Spot electricity price" field (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expects a spot-price sensor (kr/kWh), which normally comes from the **Strømligning** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for this required field, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Strømligning (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its price sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Strømligning is installed.
